# proof-carrying-models

> Defensive publication: model artifacts that prove their own history — lineage from null, evals count only with reproducible digests, the tier is derived never declared. CC0 prior art.

proof-carrying-models is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
